_comment: Site registry. How each site exposes discounts, what works, what doesn't. Update every run. A starting point, not a whitelist.

sites.name: Running Warehouse
sites.discount_exposure: Brand clearance pages work reliably. catpage-SALEM.html / MRSHOE / Mens_Running_Shoes_Sale all 404 as of 2026-09. Known-good pattern: catpage-<BRAND>MS.html e.g. catpage-ALTRAMS.html
gotchas: Category grid prices disagree with product pages in BOTH directions. Confirmed 2026-09-09: grid said Torin 8 White/Blue $79.88, PDP said $99.88.
'Compare at' figures are algorithmic anchors, not MSRP ($263, $266, $272, $183.09, $158). Use the struck-through price shown, or manufacturer list.
Per-size stock IS server-rendered. Plain fetch works.

OPEN QUESTION: a Haiku subagent reported an 'Extra 20% Off in Cart' badge on 11 SKUs on 2026-09-09. User verified in cart that no discount applied. Cause was a leading extraction prompt. Never re-introduce that phrasing. Determine independently whether such a badge renders at all.

sites.name: Zappos
sites.discount_exposure: men-running-shoes category with percentOff sort. Sitewide code banners appear and vanish (BONUS20 present 09-07 and 09-08, absent 09-09).
gotchas: Per-size stock is JS-rendered. Plain fetch returns 'unreadable' — 11 of 16 PDPs failed 2026-09-09. NEEDS PLAYWRIGHT. This is the single biggest fixable coverage gap.
Per-SKU code eligibility is not observable without a cart. Price at shelf, annotate the code.

sites.name: Sierra
sites.discount_exposure: Product pages read cleanly. Main mens-running-shoes listing has returned HTTP 500 on six consecutive runs — no discovery possible.
gotchas: Size selector lists sizes but attaches no stock count.

sites.name: REI / REI Garage
sites.discount_exposure: Garage page readable. Main category is robots-disallowed.
gotchas: Nothing has cleared 30% off a $130+ list in several runs. Consider demoting to tier 2.

sites.name: adidas
sites.discount_exposure: men-running-shoes listing carries the code banner; PDPs carry the code terms and any end date.
gotchas: Listing banner and PDP terms can state different things. Report both verbatim.

sites.name: Altra
sites.discount_exposure: Sale landing page AND product pages, which disagree. Confirmed 2026-09-09: grid showed FWD VIA $128, PDP showed $80.
gotchas: PDP wins. PDPs do expose per-size availability with low-inventory flags.

sites.name: Saucony
sites.discount_exposure: Sale listing gives prices. Individual PDPs 404 consistently; on-site search robots-disallowed. Sizes unreadable.
gotchas: Code FAST is free shipping, not a discount.
